title: Can an LLM dream? Testing the overfitted brain hypothesis on an agent with text memory
author: Eric Zou
description: arXiv:2611.21648v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hoel (2021) proposed that dreams distort replayed experience so that the brain does not overfit to recent events.
